ranked_facts.why: The presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies is a specific marker for Anti-TIF-1γ juvenile dermatomyositis, which cannot be explained by Polymorphous Light Eruption or other candidates.

Elevated serum IFN-β levels are often associated with autoimmune disorders, and in this context, they support Anti-TIF-1γ juvenile dermatomyositis over Polymorphous Light Eruption and other candidates.
